stemMd: If the alarm sounds, the guard investigates. If the guard investigates, a log entry is made. No log entry was made. Which statement follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A log entry will be made next week.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The alarm sounded but was ignored.

explanationMd: The implications form alarm → investigation → log entry. No log entry rules out investigation and then rules out an alarm sounding. This uses the rules as stated; it does not diagnose why no alarm sounded.

distractorRationale.d: Absence of a sounding event does not prove malfunction.

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "key_matched"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): Alarm implies investigation implies log; no log contrapositively excludes alarm.
